messages:
Maria: Heads-up — we're changing the internal routing contract used by hosted/dedicated. Need to align SDKs + console mapping before canary. Main change: move per-request routing metadata into a structured payload instead of ad-hoc headers.

Kevin: Is this the one that introduces `route_meta` and deprecates `X-RD-Quota-Key`? Need to understand backward compat guarantees.

Maria: Yes. New wire: payload will contain `route_meta: { id, owner, cost_center }`. Servers will accept the old header and the new payload for a transition period. Long term clients should send route_meta.

Sophia: Console concern: the dashboard currently keys quota attribution off `X-RD-Quota-Key`. If clients move to payload-only we need a canonical key derivation. Proposal: canonical_key = route_meta.owner || quota_key || route_id.

Ashwin: Telemetry note: we should add a `sampling_hint` and `route_migration.phase` tag so metrics/trace ingest can filter and we can compare old vs new. Otherwise the new dims will explode our panels.

Maria: Can we do a feature-flagged rollout? Idea: SDKs have `use_route_meta_v1` flag. Server accepts both forms for 90 days. Feature flag lets us enable per-customer canary.

Kevin: Go client will likely need a minor semver bump (breaking change to request struct). Python/TS can be opt-in via optional param. I'll schedule PRs.

DeployBot: CI: go-sdk PR #442 failed — linter error after renaming exported type.

Sophia: For the console UX, should we show both old and new mappings side-by-side during canary, or only the new mapping with a migration badge?

Maria: Side-by-side with a warning badge + tooltip. Users should be able to assert the two mappings match before we hide the old one.

Ashwin: Also add `route_migration.phase` values: `canary`, `partial`, `ga` so alerting rules can scope. I'll add to the telemetry spec.

Kevin: Rollout plan draft: 1) spec + examples, 2) Go patch (v1.5.0) + compatibility tests, 3) Py/TS opt-in flags, 4) console mapping UI + compare tile, 5) 90-day dual-accept window, 6) remove header after window. Comments?

Sophia: Need a dashboard tile that compares token burn and request counts per canonical_key old vs new over 7d and 30d. I'll mock the tile and share.

Maria: TL;DR: coordinate canary next Tue. I'll publish the spec + rollout checklist today. @Kevin @Ashwin please add SDK acceptance tests and telemetry instrumentation.

Kevin: On it. I'll add an E2E that posts both header and payload and asserts server canonicalization and quota attribution.

Ashwin: I'll update telemetry schema and the alerting doc (include sample queries).

DeployBot: CI green on go-sdk PR #443 after reverting the rename. :tada:

Maria: Great — thanks everyone. We'll do a short sync on Mon to align the console tile and tests.
